title: Make repository environments ready and recoverable
what: Production recovery now uses a prepared coding image, explicit 1 vCPU/4 GiB/16,000 MB resources, bounded legacy package repair, shallow clones, and native per-tool workspace checkpoints. A real copainter clone and read-only hash verification after restart passed; the initial old checkout was absent and its claimed preservation was withdrawn. Git push discovery scope was also corrected. Cold-session repository tests, timing regressions, additional recovery failures, and broader OS/environment support remain open. See docs/devin-parity.md.

acceptance.text: A cold session reaches a verified clone and repository test run with required tools installed
Repeated setup or network failures become visible bounded waiting states
A restart preserves or restores verified workspace state without replaying unsafe writes
Warm-start and cold-start timings are measured with a regression check
Unsupported OS or infrastructure requirements are explicit and remain tracked
